description: This file defines models and logic for managing employee holidays, including holiday statuses, per-user holiday limits, holiday requests, and logs within an Odoo module.

classes.name: hr_holidays_status
classes.description: Model representing different types of holiday statuses with color coding and activity flags.

classes.name: hr_holidays_per_user
classes.description: Model tracking maximum allowed leaves, leaves taken, and remaining leaves per employee and holiday status.

classes.name: hr_holidays
classes.description: Model for holiday requests including start/end dates, status, associated employee, and validation logic.

classes.name: holiday_user_log
classes.description: Model for logging actions related to holiday requests.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: strToDate
methods.description: Converts a date string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format to a date object.

methods.name: _get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves for a user based on validated holiday records.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides create method to set user_id based on employee.

methods.name: _update_user_holidays
methods.description: Updates leaves taken or resets holiday data when a holiday is validated or canceled.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that holiday start/end dates and number of days are consistent.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets a holiday request to draft state.

methods.name: holidays_validate
methods.description: Validates a holiday request, updates leaves, and creates associated case.

methods.name: holidays_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a holiday request, sets user, and creates associated case.

methods.name: holidays_refuse
methods.description: Refuses a holiday request and updates manager info.

methods.name: holidays_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a holiday request and updates user holiday data.

methods.name: holidays_draft
methods.description: Resets a holiday request to draft state.

methods.name: check_holidays
methods.description: Checks if holiday request exceeds available leaves and creates or updates case accordingly.

methods.name: _create_holiday
methods.description: Associates a holiday record with the user's holiday history.

methods.name: onchange_date_to
methods.description: Calculates number of days based on start and end date inputs.
